function.name: explora/free/q-elevon-psf
function.description: Chordwise dynamic pressure of the free-stream elevon fraction, 1/2 rho max(u, 0)^2 (crossflow through the wing gives a flap nothing)

function.name: explora/strip/left/u-fps
function.description: Chordwise (body X) velocity in the left slipstream: u + k v_i of engine 0 (left, Propulsion.xml y -0.325)

function.name: explora/strip/left/alpha-rad
function.description: Local angle of attack of the left washed strip, atan2(w, u + k v_i): 0 at hover, where the tables return the 3 deg incidence lift

function.name: explora/strip/left/q-psf
function.description: 1/2 rho ((u + k v_i)^2 + w^2): the strip's dynamic pressure in its symmetry plane (the partner of explora/qbar-xz-psf)

function.name: explora/strip/left/q-elevon-psf
function.description: Chordwise dynamic pressure the washed part of the left elevon sees: q_free + min(1/2 rho max(u + k v_i, 0)^2 - q_free, C T_0), the wash increment capped at the jet's momentum flux (a flap in still air cannot push harder than T sin delta); a flap in reversed flow is not modelled

function.name: explora/strip/left/X-lbs
function.description: Body-X force of the left strip: q_s S_s (CX(alpha_s) - CD0 cos alpha_s), the free-stream tables at the strip's own alpha

function.name: explora/strip/left/Z-lbs
function.description: Body-Z force of the left strip: q_s S_s (CZ(alpha_s) - CD0 sin alpha_s); at hover -CL0 q_s S_s, the wash normal force

function.name: explora/strip/left/Pitch-lbsft
function.description: Moment of the left strip about the AERORP: Cm(alpha_s) q_s S_s c_s + Z_s x arm, arm = strip quarter chord aft of the wing's area-mean quarter chord

function.name: explora/strip/right/u-fps
function.description: Chordwise (body X) velocity in the right slipstream: u + k v_i of engine 1 (right, Propulsion.xml y +0.325)

function.name: explora/strip/right/alpha-rad
function.description: Local angle of attack of the right washed strip, atan2(w, u + k v_i): 0 at hover, where the tables return the 3 deg incidence lift

function.name: explora/strip/right/q-psf
function.description: 1/2 rho ((u + k v_i)^2 + w^2): the strip's dynamic pressure in its symmetry plane (the partner of explora/qbar-xz-psf)

function.name: explora/strip/right/q-elevon-psf
function.description: Chordwise dynamic pressure the washed part of the right elevon sees: q_free + min(1/2 rho max(u + k v_i, 0)^2 - q_free, C T_1), the wash increment capped at the jet's momentum flux (a flap in still air cannot push harder than T sin delta); a flap in reversed flow is not modelled

function.name: explora/strip/right/X-lbs
function.description: Body-X force of the right strip: q_s S_s (CX(alpha_s) - CD0 cos alpha_s), the free-stream tables at the strip's own alpha

function.name: explora/strip/right/Z-lbs
function.description: Body-Z force of the right strip: q_s S_s (CZ(alpha_s) - CD0 sin alpha_s); at hover -CL0 q_s S_s, the wash normal force

function.name: explora/strip/right/Pitch-lbsft
function.description: Moment of the right strip about the AERORP: Cm(alpha_s) q_s S_s c_s + Z_s x arm, arm = strip quarter chord aft of the wing's area-mean quarter chord

function.name: explora/elevon/sym-psf-rad
function.description: Symmetric elevon input weighted by the dynamic pressure each part of the elevon span sees: (1 - phi) q_free e + phi/2 (q_L (e + a) + q_R (e - a)), phi = share of one elevon inside its strip

function.name: explora/elevon/asym-psf-rad
function.description: Antisymmetric elevon input weighted the same way: (1 - phi) q_free a + phi/2 (q_L (e + a) - q_R (e - a)); with equal wash it is q_elevon x aileron

function.name: explora/qbar-xz-psf
function.description: 1/2 rho (u^2 + w^2) = qbar cos^2 beta: dynamic pressure of the flow in the symmetry plane, what the alpha tables were built on; zero in pure spanwise flow

function.name: explora/crossflow/side-force-lbs
function.description: Broadside drag of the fuselage side projection and the fins, -CD 1/2 rho v|v| A_side; the large-beta partner of the sin cos beta derivatives

function.name: aero/coefficient/CX_alpha
function.description: Body-X coefficient without CD0: -CDi cos a + CL sin a

function.name: aero/coefficient/CZ_alpha
function.description: Body-Z coefficient without CD0: -CL cos a - CDi sin a

function.name: aero/coefficient/Cm_alpha
function.description: Pitching moment about the neutral point: Cm0 to stall, flat-plate centre-of-pressure law beyond

function.name: aero/force/X_alpha
function.description: Free-stream part of the planform (centre section + outboard wing) at the aircraft alpha

function.name: aero/force/X_parasite
function.description: CD0 along the wind, X component, free-stream part. Buildup at 16 m/s: wing 0.0112, fuselage 0.0034, fins 0.0014, motors 0.0062, fin tube ends 0.0019, ball caps 0.0005, +15 % misc (chosen)

function.name: aero/force/X_strips
function.description: The two washed strips (shared functions above)

function.name: aero/force/Y_crossflow
function.description: Broadside drag of fuselage and fins, -CD 1/2 rho v|v| A_side (shared function above)

function.name: aero/force/Z_alpha
function.description: Free-stream part of the planform at the aircraft alpha

function.name: aero/force/Z_parasite
function.description: CD0 along the wind, Z component, free-stream part

function.name: aero/force/Z_strips
function.description: The two washed strips: the wash normal force in hover (4.94 N up at 3.4 kg hover thrust), the blown-wing lift in flight

function.name: aero/force/Z_propwash_pitchrate
function.description: Pitch-rate lift of the washed strips in hover: 1/4 rho S c CZq f_strip x (k v_i) x q per strip, wash increment only (the force partner of Pitch_propwash_damp)

function.name: aero/force/Z_elevator
function.description: Elevon lift (symmetric), body Z, on the dynamic-pressure-weighted deflection so it exists in hover

function.name: aero/moment/Roll_aileron
function.description: Differential elevon on the dynamic-pressure-weighted deflection: this is the hover heading control

function.name: aero/moment/Roll_strips
function.description: Normal forces of the two strips at +-y_strip: zero for equal thrust, the differential-thrust roll coupling otherwise

function.name: aero/moment/Roll_propwash_damp
function.description: Roll damping of the washed strips in hover: 1/4 rho S b^2 Clp f_roll x (k v_i) x p per strip, the wash increment only so cruise Clp is not double-counted

function.name: aero/moment/Pitch_alpha
function.description: Free-stream part: Cm0 about the neutral point (+0.0146, nose up at zero lift) and the post-stall moment; NO Cm_alpha, the AERORP-to-CG arm supplies it

function.name: aero/moment/Pitch_free_arm
function.description: Free-stream normal force times its quarter-chord arm from the area-mean quarter chord (the strips' arms and this one sum to zero over the planform)

function.name: aero/moment/Pitch_strips
function.description: The two washed strips about the AERORP (Cm0 + quarter-chord arm; at hover +0.121 N m nose up)

function.name: aero/moment/Pitch_elevator
function.description: Symmetric elevon about the neutral point on the dynamic-pressure-weighted deflection: at hover -0.045 N m per degree about the CG

function.name: aero/moment/Pitch_propwash_damp
function.description: Pitch damping of the washed strips in hover: 1/4 rho S c^2 Cmq f_strip x (k v_i) x q per strip, wash increment only (quadtailsitter pattern)

function.name: aero/moment/Yaw_crossflow
function.description: Weathercock moment of the broadside drag about the AERORP: -x_cp x Y_crossflow, the force centre 57 mm aft of the AERORP; JSBSim adds the AERORP-to-CG arm (12.7 mm) itself, giving 70 mm aft of the CG

function.name: aero/moment/Yaw_strips
function.description: Axial forces of the two strips at +-y_strip: yaw = -y_L X_L - y_R X_R = y (X_L - X_R), zero for equal thrust
